component.name: ClamGuardian
component.summary: Security framework for ClamAV scanning and quarantine vaulting

description.p: ClamGuardian provides antivirus scanning, encrypted quarantine vaulting, threat intelligence integration, and event-driven monitoring for Linux.
ClamGuardian 1.0 Release featuring profile-aware history, encrypted AES-256-GCM quarantine vault, and ClamAV engine integration.
